suites.title: TOOL-2 Customer registration, sign-in and account protection

specs.title: SCN-001: A new customer registers and the API answers 201 with their details and an id

steps.title: Given a new customer with a unique e-mail address
When their details are posted to POST /users/register
Then the API responds 201 with the customer's details and an id

specs.title: SCN-002: Registering an already registered e-mail address again is refused with 409

steps.title: Given a customer already registered with an e-mail address
[SEED] registered customer hldout-ulcl6mvp-1@example.com
When the same e-mail address is registered again
Then the API responds 409 with the message "A customer with this email address already exists."

specs.title: SCN-003: Registering with the password "abc" is refused with 422 and all four password rules

steps.title: Given a new customer whose password is "abc"
When they register
Then the API responds 422 and the password errors state all four rules

specs.title: SCN-004: A registered customer signs in on the web shop and lands on "My account" with their name shown

steps.title: Given a registered customer on the web shop's sign-in page
[SEED] registered customer hldout-ulcl6bqq-1@example.com
When they sign in with their e-mail address and password
Then they land on the "My account" page
And the navigation shows their first and last name

specs.title: SCN-005: Signing in with a wrong password is refused by POST /users/login with 401

steps.title: Given a registered customer
[SEED] registered customer hldout-ulcm5tis-2@example.com
When they sign in with a wrong password
Then POST /users/login responds 401

specs.title: SCN-007: After GET /users/logout the same token gets 401 from GET /users/me

steps.title: Given a signed-in customer with an access token
[SEED] registered customer hldout-ulcm5xwc-2@example.com
[SEED] sign in hldout-ulcm5xwc-2@example.com (POST /users/login)
[SEED] the token is accepted by GET /users/me before signing out
When they sign out with GET /users/logout
Then GET /users/me with the same token responds 401

specs.title: SCN-008: The registration answer does not contain the password

steps.title: Given a new customer with a unique e-mail address
When their details are posted to POST /users/register
Then the response does not contain the password

specs.title: SCN-009: Simultaneous registrations of one e-mail address: exactly one is accepted, the others get 409

steps.title: Given a new, unregistered e-mail address (round 1)
When three customers register it at the same moment (round 1)
Then exactly one registration is accepted and the others respond 409 (round 1)
Given a new, unregistered e-mail address (round 2)
When three customers register it at the same moment (round 2)
Then exactly one registration is accepted and the others respond 409 (round 2)
Given a new, unregistered e-mail address (round 3)
When three customers register it at the same moment (round 3)
Then exactly one registration is accepted and the others respond 409 (round 3)

specs.title: SCN-010.1: A password of 7 characters meeting every other rule is rejected

steps.title: Given a new customer whose password has 7 characters, with upper and lower case letters, a symbol and a number
When they register
Then the API responds 422 and the password errors state the rule: at least 8 characters

specs.title: SCN-010.2: A password of 8 characters meeting every other rule is accepted

steps.title: Given a new customer whose password has 8 characters, with upper and lower case letters, a symbol and a number
When they register
Then the registration is accepted

specs.title: SCN-011.1: A password with no upper case letter is refused with 422 and the rule "upper and lower case letters"

steps.title: Given a new customer whose password has no upper case letter
When they register
Then the API responds 422 and the password errors state the rule: upper and lower case letters

specs.title: SCN-011.2: A password with no lower case letter is refused with 422 and the rule "upper and lower case letters"

steps.title: Given a new customer whose password has no lower case letter
When they register
Then the API responds 422 and the password errors state the rule: upper and lower case letters

specs.title: SCN-011.3: A password with no symbol is refused with 422 and the rule "a symbol"

steps.title: Given a new customer whose password has no symbol
When they register
Then the API responds 422 and the password errors state the rule: a symbol

specs.title: SCN-011.4: A password with no number is refused with 422 and the rule "a number"

steps.title: Given a new customer whose password has no number
When they register
Then the API responds 422 and the password errors state the rule: a number

specs.title: SCN-012: Signing in on the web shop with a wrong password shows "Invalid email or password"

steps.title: Given a registered customer on the web shop's sign-in page
[SEED] registered customer hldout-ulcokbyx-4@example.com
When they sign in with a wrong password
Then the web shop shows "Invalid email or password"

specs.title: SCN-013: Signing out with GET /users/logout answers a 2xx success

steps.title: Given a signed-in customer with an access token
[SEED] registered customer hldout-ulcop7j3-6@example.com
[SEED] sign in hldout-ulcop7j3-6@example.com (POST /users/login)
When they sign out with GET /users/logout
Then GET /users/logout answers a 2xx success (body not checked)
